title: Why Sun State is One of the Top Fleet Service Providers
description: Every vehicle in your operation plays a critical role in your business, and even one unexpected breakdown can create a ripple effect of missed deliveries, unhappy customers, and lost revenue. That’s why choosing the right fleet service providers matters.

props.text: Uptime is the only fleet metric that matters

Every vehicle in your operation plays a critical role in your business, and even one unexpected breakdown can create a ripple effect of missed deliveries, unhappy customers, and lost revenue. That’s why choosing the right fleet service providers matters.

Sun State International is a Florida International truck service center providing fleet repair and maintenance, quality OEM parts and technicians whose job is to keep your units earning. Fleet work is judged on one thing, and it is not the hourly rate.
The best fleet service providers prevent disruptions rather than reacting to them. That comes down to a few things working together.

items.label: Proactive maintenance
items.desc: Scheduled work built around how your units actually run, so problems are found in the bay instead of on the road.

items.label: Sales, service and parts together
items.desc: With all three working from the same building, fleets spend less time waiting and more time on the road.

items.label: Factory-trained technicians
items.desc: As an authorized International truck service center, our technicians know these trucks in depth rather than in general.

items.label: An OEM parts inventory
items.desc: Genuine International components on the shelf reduce repair delays, and parts engineered for the vehicle hold up longer.

props.text: Family-owned, and it shows in how we work

We have built this business over three decades on hard work, dependable service and genuine relationships. Customers are treated as part of an extended family, which in practice means straightforward answers, practical solutions and no interest in selling work that does not need doing.
For a fleet manager, that is worth more than a rate card. It means you can call and get a real answer about whether a unit should go in now or run to the next scheduled service.
Talk to us about your fleet

If you run units across West Central Florida, we can set up a maintenance schedule around your routes and your duty cycles rather than a generic interval. Call the number below and ask for the service department at the location nearest your yard.
